name: The Way to Auberdine
summary: The Way to Auberdine marks an essential diplomatic bridge connecting the remote western islands to Kalimdor's mainland. Carrying a letter of introduction from Huntress Kella Nightbow, travelers journey by vessel across the sea to deliver word of distant perils to Thundris Windweaver in Darkshore. This simple crossing formalizes a growing pact of mutual defense between the night elves and newfound allies.

sections.title: Crossing the Sea
sections.body: For travelers emerging from the trials of the northern isles, the journey across the waters represents an entry into the broader Alliance theater. Huntress Kella Nightbow arranges passage from the island docks aboard the ferry bound for Darkshore. Carrying a sealed Letter of Introduction, the voyager is tasked with establishing contact with Thundris Windweaver, a respected night elf citizen of Auberdine. The voyage serves as both a diplomatic mission and an invitation to delve into the troubled wilderness of northern Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Legacy of Ancient Grounds
sections.body: Upon receiving the letter, Thundris Windweaver reflects on the shared history binding the regions together. The islands of Azuremyst and Bloodmyst were long ago inhabited by the night elves, and the encroaching dangers faced by settlements there are no novelty to his people. Recognizing ancient adversaries, Thundris pledges that the community of Auberdine and the local Sentinels will offer whatever aid they can muster, ensuring that the isolated islanders do not stand alone against gathering threats.

faq.q: Who starts the journey to Auberdine?
aliases: who gives the way to auberdine
where do i get the quest
faq.answer: The journey begins with Huntress Kella Nightbow, a night elf sentinel stationed near the docks on Bloodmyst Isle. She entrusts travelers with a letter of introduction intended for her trusted friend across the water.

faq.q: Who receives the letter in Auberdine?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: The letter must be handed to Thundris Windweaver, a respected resident of Auberdine. He can be found in the town on the mainland coast of Darkshore, typically inside the large cross-shaped building situated just north of the town's primary docks.

faq.q: Why is this letter being sent to Auberdine?
faq.answer: The letter alerts the night elf leadership in Darkshore to the situation unfolding on the islands. It formalizes requests for aid on behalf of Anchorite Paetheus and appeals to historical ties, inviting mainland support against ancient shared foes.

faq.q: How do you reach Darkshore from the docks?
aliases: how do i cross the sea
faq.answer: Travelers wait on the dock near Huntress Kella Nightbow for the transport vessel sailing between the islands and Auberdine. Once boarded, the ship carries passengers directly across the sea into the harbor of Darkshore.

faq.q: What connection do the night elves have to the western isles?
faq.answer: As Thundris Windweaver notes, the isles known as Azuremyst and Bloodmyst were ancient night elf territories long before the recent arrival of new allies. The threats currently menacing those shores are longstanding enemies the kaldorei have contested for generations.

faq.q: What happens after the letter is delivered?
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver promises to confer with the local townspeople and the Sentinels to coordinate relief efforts and send word back to Anchorite Paetheus, opening up further journeys and duties throughout Darkshore for the adventurer.

angles.text: This voyage cements early diplomatic and military cooperation, integrating newly arrived refugees and island outposts firmly into the fold of the Alliance.
For night elves, the quest is a reminder of forgotten ancestral outposts in the misty western seas, now re-emerging with ancient evils that demand kaldorei vigilance.
